issues.description: In the solution the PUT endpoint for updating a person declares the path variable as a String (@PathVariable("personId") String personId) while the corresponding DELETE endpoint and the NoteResource use UUID typed path variables. This inconsistency in the path-variable type for personId (String vs UUID) is structural and may confuse students about the expected path variable type and how to validate the incoming ID. The problem statement and NoteResource imply using UUIDs for resource IDs, so the person update endpoint should consistently use UUID as well.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person update endpoint use a UUID path variable to match the other endpoints and the overall API design. For example change the method signature to use @PathVariable("personId") UUID personId and validate with updatedPerson.getId().equals(personId). This keeps the API consistent and avoids confusion about whether the ID is a UUID or string.
